checks.text: The page heading is "Family Calendar" and the default view is the month grid for the current month, with the tab "Week" visible and not selected (`aria-selected="false"`).

In the month view, clicking the button "Add event" opens a form; typing "Dentist" in the field labelled "Title", "2025-06-10" in "Date", "14:00" in "Time", and clicking "Save" closes the form, switches the month grid to June 2025 (heading "June 2025"), and the June 10 cell contains one event chip whose text contains both "Dentist" and "14:00".

After saving Dentist as in A2, clicking the tab "Week" shows the week of June 8-14, 2025 (the week, Sunday to Saturday, containing the most recently saved event's date); the cell for Tuesday June 10 contains an event chip whose text contains "Dentist" and "14:00".

In the event form, typing "Yoga" in "Title", "2025-06-12" in "Date", "09:00" in "Time", selecting "Weekly" in the select labelled "Repeat" and clicking "Save" creates exactly three events, on June 12, June 19 and June 26, 2025; the month grid for June 2025 shows an event chip containing "Yoga" and "09:00" in each of those three cells.
After saving Dentist (2025-06-10 14:00), clicking the button "Export ICS" downloads a file whose content includes the lines "SUMMARY:Dentist" and "DTSTART:20250610T140000".

Clicking the tab "Tasks", typing "Buy milk" in the field labelled "New task" and clicking "Add" adds a checklist item with the text "Buy milk" and an unchecked checkbox; the progress indicator reads "0/1".
After adding the task "Buy milk", ticking its checkbox changes the progress indicator to "1/1" and the text "Buy milk" gets a line-through text decoration.

After saving Dentist (2025-06-10 14:00), clicking the button "Delete Dentist" in the June 10 cell removes it: the June 10 cell has no "Dentist" chip, and after clicking the tab "Week" the week view contains no "Dentist".

After saving Dentist (2025-06-10 14:00) and adding and ticking the task "Buy milk", reloading the page keeps the event: the month grid (navigated to June 2025 with the "Previous month"/"Next month" buttons if needed) has a chip containing "Dentist" in the June 10 cell, and the Tasks tab shows "Buy milk" ticked with progress "1/1".
